title: Article Analytics Dashboard — PR A: analytics foundation + instrumentation
scope: PR A (write-side foundation + instrumentation). IFC-304 overall remains IN PROGRESS — PR B (helpArticle.getAnalytics read-side + article-analytics.tsx admin dashboard) follows and consumes these tables.
summary: Write-side foundation for help-article analytics. Adds 3 additive Prisma tables (HelpArticleViewDaily, HelpArticleSearchNoResultDaily, HelpArticleAnalyticsDedup), a privacy-preserving domain normalizer (PII redaction + length limit + no identity), a HelpArticleAnalyticsRepository port, its PrismaHelpArticleAnalyticsRepository adapter (atomic upsert-increment + optional idempotency guard), two tenantProcedure mutations (helpArticle.recordView / recordSearchNoResult), and retention-purge wiring. Views/no-result searches are stored ONLY as per-tenant, per-UTC-day aggregate counters — no user/session identity, no raw search string. Writes are atomic and idempotent-per-key (increment-first, guard-last, so a P2002 rolls the whole transaction back). Migration is Class A (additive, backward-compatible, non-destructive) with zero schema/DB drift verified.

tests/integration/help-article-analytics.test.ts 5/5 against real Postgres at localhost:5433 (intelliflow_test) — atomic increment, transaction-rollback idempotency (dup key => deduped, count unchanged), two-tenant isolation, PII-redacted term storage, batched retention purge. Located in tests/integration/ so it actually runs in the CI Integration Tests lane + pre-ship.
pnpm --filter @intelliflow/api... build succeeded (all workspace deps + api bundles + DTS).

New executable code >=90%: adapter file lines 94.1% / statements 92.7% / functions 94.1% from unit tests alone; the 5 integration tests additionally cover the real transaction and purge paths. Domain normalizer fully exercised (12 cases incl. redaction, truncation, UTC bucketing, retention cutoff). The application port is interface-only (no executable statements).

Every repository method filters by explicit tenantId. Unit: recordView rejects a foreign article with NOT_FOUND and never increments. Integration: tenant B's views/searches never appear under tenant A and vice-versa. DB-level RLS policies added on all 3 tables (defense in depth).

Single $transaction; increment via upsert { increment: 1 } (no read-modify-write race); optional idempotency guard inserted last so a duplicate key (P2002) rolls the transaction back. Verified against real DB.

20260726120000_help_article_analytics creates 3 NEW tables only (no existing-table column changes, no data rewrite, no destructive DDL). Applied to the test DB via the intended path (psql/db execute, never db push / reset / migrate dev). prisma migrate diff (schema vs DB) reports NO drift on the new tables. RLS enabled + explicit tenant_isolation policies. Rollback = DROP the 3 tables; feature disables at the call site without reverting schema.

purgeExpiredRecords extended to purge expired idempotency guards (48h TTL) and out-of-retention aggregates (400-day window) with the same batched deleteMany discipline as AuditLogEntry; folded into PurgeResult.totalPurged.
